description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) across varying numbers of queries used during inference, with the x-axis representing the "Number of queries used during inference (S)" on a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, and the y-axis showing MRR@10 values from 33.0 to 36.5. The plot compares the performance of different retrieval methods, each represented by a distinct line: DPR w/ gold (black solid line), DPR w/ top-1 (green solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple dashed line with circle markers), DPR w/ random (blue dashed line with circle markers), and DPR w/ curriculum (red dashed line with circle markers). The green line for DPR w/ top-1 starts at an MRR@10 of approximately 33.0 when S=1 and increases sharply to about 36.5 by S=10. The black line for DPR w/ gold starts at 33.0 when S=1 and remains relatively flat, increasing only slightly to around 34.5 by S=10. The purple dashed line for DPR w/ bottom-1 begins at approximately 34.9 and remains relatively stable, ending around 34.6. The blue dashed line for DPR w/ random starts at about 34.8 and shows a slight increase to around 35.1. The red dashed line for DPR w/ curriculum starts at approximately 35.0 and remains stable, ending at about 35.6. The dashed horizontal lines at MRR@10 = 35.5 and 34.5 serve as reference points for the performance levels.
